newsitem.title: USA: Titan Wheel to acquire American Welding.
newsitem.headline: Titan Wheel to acquire American Welding.

text.p: Titan Wheel International Inc said Monday it has signed a letter of intent to purchase the assets of American Welding of Warren, Ohio, from Freedom Forge. Terms were not disclosed.

Titan said it is acquiring the complete Warren facility and will establish a development center for its new patent-pending multi-piece off-highway wheels, using the plant's capacity to produce rolled and seamless rings.

"It is our belief that the process we are developing will lower the cost of wheels, plus allow Titan to produce a design superior to all our competition in the construction wheel market," said Maurice Taylor Jr, Titan president, in a statement.
The purchase of this 300,000 square foot facility will close on or before May 15, 1997.
Titan makes mounted tire and wheel systems for off-highway equipment used in agriculture, construction, mining, military, recreation and grounds care.
